headline: T Swift's Baddies Drop a 196-Burger While Little Peckers Stay Little
subhead: Week 10 had a 111-point bloodbath, a Jacoby Brissett hot-potato tour, and JT trying to single-handedly end QAmon's season.
matchOfTheWeek: McBridesStrangeWhiteHock squeaked past Christian McCalfinjury by 6.60 in the only game that didn't feel like assault. Trey McBride dropping 32.2 on his namesake owner is the kind of cosmic alignment you can't script. Meanwhile McCalfinjury left Dalton Schultz and his 21.8 rotting on the bench — congrats Matt, you lost by six and had a TE2 outscoring half your starters in street clothes.
powerRankingsShakeup: T Swift's Baddies just put up the highest score of the week with 98.9% efficiency and are officially the team nobody wants to draw. Little Peckers and Rub My Chubb are in freefall — one couldn't crack 85, the other left a full RB on the bench.
mainRecap:
Let's start at the morgue: Little Peckers scored 84.22. EIGHTY-FOUR. T Swift's Baddies hung 196 on you while Gibbs (38.2) and Stafford (26.9) treated your roster like a tackling dummy. That's not a loss, that's a hate crime. Unc and the boys need a wellness check.

The Good Ladds dropped 182.98 on QAmon because Jonathan Taylor decided Week 10 was the day he scored FORTY-NINE POINT SIX. Mig also pulled off the trade of the century — flipping picks for Jacoby Brissett (the artist formerly known as 120% Kyler) right before Top 27 went down. Meanwhile Kyle watched Dillon Gabriel drop 20 on his bench while dead rat and Tiny-Handed Vampire combined for jack squat. The ARbiter has ruled: you're cooked.

Browning Out put up 159 behind a 40.5 Achane explosion against Rub My Chubb, who somehow still managed to leave 34.2 points on the bench. Big D, Jalen Nailor went for 23.4 in your shorts pocket. Kittle's 27.9 wasn't enough because you're allergic to setting a lineup.

Stroud Boys had Money Mill$ go for 28.68 and The Prodigal Son punch in 28 — and STILL lost to Egbukkake. Jewett also spent the week running a Brissett-and-Mills clearance sale, dumping both for picks like he's tanking, except he's 4-whatever and just lost. Strange strategy, my guy.

Nut Olave Your Face beat OnlyFants behind a 25-spot from Nail polish enthusiast, but Tez Johnson put up 20.2 on the bench. Cubby's Jeudy also went for 19.8 in street clothes — both of you stop drafting depth you refuse to play.

McBride owner rode McBride to victory. Poetry. Everyone else, see you in hell.

weeklyAwards.blurb: 196 to 84 isn't a matchup, it's a war crime tribunal exhibit.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Coach of the Year
weeklyAwards.blurb: Lost by 49.92 with 34.2 points sitting on the pine — Jalen Nailor went nuclear in your back pocket.

weeklyAwards.title: Hot Potato Trophy
weeklyAwards.blurb: Acquired Brissett, traded Brissett, traded Money Mill$ — bro is running a fantasy garage sale mid-playoff push.

weeklyAwards.title: Jonathan Taylor Memorial Single-Handed Victory
weeklyAwards.blurb: JT dropped 49.6 and Mig didn't even need the rest of the roster to bury QAmon by 58.
